gateContract.inWorldReason: REQUIRED on every gate record: why, inside the fiction, this stops you (snowed pass, dojo door, one-way current)
gateContract.opensWith: the #12 fact class that opens it (flag / #117 technique / #127 discovery kind)
gateContract.validation: a gate whose reason cannot be said in-world fails landing validation — it is a defect, not a gate

blockSet.law: CLOSED set of two. A block with no geography and no gate record — an invisible wall — is unrepresentable in this shape, on purpose

earlyArrival: #139's two-class law is built into the ground: world-open live on presence, story-locked test their own flags; danger reads dangerous in presentation (#152/#215/look) before it proves it — warning is presentation, mercy is never machinery
note: Brief cited '#142's early-discovery ruling'; the ruling's landed home is #139 (142 is regional climate). Reconciliation registered in STAGING. Zero terrain records instanced — contents are the world-data pass.
routeAsPlace: a route is an area like any other: #7 tables, #61 weather, #152 behaviour, width. Corridors exist only where geography makes them (pass, bridge, cave mouth) — authored, never default

terrainRecord.areaRef: #11 node / area id — terrain hangs off the graph, never replaces it
terrainRecord.dangerBand: #52 band reference read from the area's own #7 tables — authored, never scaled to the visitor (#139)
terrainRecord.edges: each edge is geography (the land ends/turns) or a #127 connection / #140 border zone — nothing else joins areas
terrainRecord.sightLines: presentation data: what of the next country is visible from here; #137's atlas derivation reads the same facts so eye and map cannot disagree
